description:
Modify standing spend caps, route allowlist, or label on an active delegated key without rotating its secret. Use this to adjust ongoing budgets; do not use to mint keys (x402_issue_delegate_key), approve one-time exceptions (x402_decide_approval), or disable keys (x402_revoke_delegate_key).
Parameters: omitted fields stay unchanged, null clears a cap, allowed_routes=[] permits all routes; supply master spend_key/header (mismatch -> HTTP 400).
Behavior: takes effect immediately without resetting usage counters; HTTP 403 delegates, HTTP 404 unknown, HTTP 401 revoked, 120 req/min/IP.

allowed_routes.description: Route allowlist patterns restricting which capabilities the delegated key may invoke (supports exact routes like "POST /kb/search" or prefix wildcards like "GET /reality/*"). Omit or pass [] to allow all hub capabilities.

daily_budget_cents.description: Updated UTC daily budget cap in USD cents, or null to clear the daily cap.

delegate_id.description: Unique delegated subagent key identifier returned by x402_issue_delegate_key or x402_get_account (format: sbd_<16 hex chars>, e.g. sbd_1122334455667788).

label.description: Updated human-readable label for the delegated subagent key.

max_order_cents.description: Updated per-call spend cap in USD cents, or null to clear the per-call cap.

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

total_budget_cents.description: Updated lifetime cumulative cap in USD cents, or null to clear the lifetime cap.

name: x402_update_delegate_key

delegate.description: Full updated delegate policy and live spend counters.

ok.description: True when the delegate policy was updated.

title: Update Delegated Key Policy
